title: Anatomical and Clinical Knowledge Graph for Physiological Data
code: library(PhysioAnnotationHub)  # --- Load the annotation hub (bundled CSVs, no download) --- hub <- loadAnnotationHub() hub  # --- Query anatomical annotations (names are matched fuzzily) --- getMuscleAnnotation("Biceps Brachii")   # body region, action, innervation, spinal level getMuscleAnnotation("Vastus")           # all matching muscles (lateralis/medialis/intermedius) getBoneAnnotation("Femur") getNerveAnnotation("Median Nerve")  # --- Clinical codes associated with a muscle --- getClinicalCodes("Biceps Brachii")                 # ICD-10 (default) getClinicalCodes("Biceps Brachii", system = "icf") # ICF  # --- Knowledge graph: neighbours within a given depth --- kgNeighbors("Biceps Brachii", depth = 1)  # --- Knowledge graph: shortest path between two anatomical entities --- kgShortestPath("Scapula", "Radius") #> $path: "Scapula" "Humerus" "Radius"; $found: TRUE  # --- Knowledge graph: triple-pattern query --- queryKG(predicate = "innervated_by", object = "Median Nerve")  # --- Knowledge graph: over-representation analysis --- my_muscles <- c("Biceps Brachii", "Brachialis", "Pronator Teres") kgEnrichment(my_muscles, annotation_type = "nerve") #> Musculocutaneous Nerve over-represented (fold ~60, p ~2e-4)

title: PhysioAnnotationHub 0.1.0
text: Initial release standalone package physio-ecosystem. Provides centralized anatomical clinical knowledge hub — muscle, bone, nerve metadata, clinical code mappings, queryable knowledge graph — bundled curated reference data downstream musculoskeletal rehabilitation analyses.

title: PhysioAnnotationHub 0.1.0
text: Muscle annotations (body region, primary/secondary action, innervating nerve, spinal level, muscle type, joint crossed). Bone annotations (body region, bone type, parent structure). Nerve annotations (spinal levels, type, body region, plexus). Clinical code tables mapping ICD-10 ICF codes affected/related muscles, body regions, functional domains. getMuscleAnnotation(), getBoneAnnotation(), getNerveAnnotation() retrieve records name, return full table called query. getClinicalCodes() resolves ICD-10 ICF codes referencing given set muscles. queryKG() filters triples combination subject, predicate, object using grep exact matching. kgNeighbors() returns triples within given number hops entity, following outgoing incoming edges. kgShortestPath() finds shortest path two entities via breadth-first search, reporting entity path, relations traversed (inverse edges flagged), path depth. kgEnrichment() performs -representation analysis muscle set full background, testing enrichment actions, innervation, body regions, spinal levels fold-enrichment hypergeometric p-values.
